contentReferenceSemantics.nativeObjectRefRule: Opaque native file identity returned in the typed ContentReference slot under the admitted storage-space Resource; files and folders remain native children, not a second Core directory.
contentReferenceSemantics.nativeRevisionRule: Immutable native version identity. Read and export consume the frozen revision without substituting the current head; a first-byte intent is not a ContentReference and publishes no reference before immutable native ACK.
contentReferenceSemantics.authorizationTargetRule: Every native child and share must belong to the admitted Resource, scope and binding. HUMAN/AGENT list and list_revisions results use the existing typed-citations schema; SERVICE complete-list list_output is a separate read-edge transport and is neither this operation result nor proof of SERVICE conformance.
